name: enclave
_comment: The GENERIC shell: one install wraps any *.app.enclave.host deployment. It pairs at runtime via enclave://open?u=<origin>&d=<deployment id>&n=<name> (the dashboard's 'Get the app' section mints that link) or by typing the origin, and verifies whatever it wraps. Custom-domain apps and branded launcher identity stay on the per-app matrix path.
